LESSON M17

Lines, Angles, and Triangles

Angle relationships, triangle facts, and similar/congruent triangles
角的关系、三角形性质、相似与全等
ANGLESVertical angles are equal; a straight line is 180°.
PARALLEL LINESEvery angle is either equal to x or equal to 180 − x.
SIMILARSame angles; sides in the same ratio.
Concept

Angle vocabulary and the 90° / 180° rules · 角的基本词汇

Kinds of angles 角的种类

WordSize中文
acuteless than 90°锐角
rightexactly 90° (little square ⌐)直角
obtusebetween 90° and 180°钝角
straight180° (a straight line)平角

Complementary 互余: add to 90°. Supplementary 互补: add to 180°.

Angle = 35°. Complement: 90 − 35 = 55°. Supplement: 180 − 35 = 145°.

互余加起来 90°，互补加起来 180°。

Two crossing lines 两条相交直线

  • Vertical angles 对顶角: across from each other at the crossing → equal.
  • Linear pair 邻补角: side by side on a straight line → add to 180°.

Two lines cross and one angle is 40°.

  1. The angle across from it (vertical): 40°.
  2. The angles next to it (linear pair): 180 − 40 = 140°.
  3. Check: 40 + 140 + 40 + 140 = 360° (all the way around) ✓

❌ Vertical angles add to 180°. They are equal; it is the angles side by side that add to 180°.

对顶角相等；相邻在一条直线上的两个角相加 180°；绕一点一周是 360°。

Concept

Parallel lines cut by a transversal · 平行线与截线

Only two sizes! 只有两种大小

Lines m ∥ n are cut by a transversal 截线 (red). The 8 angles come in only two sizes:

  • Acute ones are all equal: 1 = 3 = 5 = 7.
  • Obtuse ones are all equal: 2 = 4 = 6 = 8.
  • Any acute + any obtuse = 180°.

Teacher example 例题

In the figure, angle 1 = 70°. Find all the others.

  1. 1 is acute, so 3, 5, 7 are also 70°.
  2. 2 and 1 make a straight line: 180 − 70 = 110°.
  3. So 2, 4, 6, 8 are all 110°.

With algebra: an acute angle is (2x + 10)° and an obtuse angle is 110°. 2x + 10 + 110 = 180 → 2x = 60 → x = 30.

平行线被截线所截：所有锐角相等，所有钝角相等，锐角 + 钝角 = 180°。名称：同位角 corresponding、内错角 alternate interior 相等；同旁内角 same-side interior 互补。

❌ Setting every pair equal. First decide: are both acute (equal) or one acute, one obtuse (add to 180°)?

Concept

Triangle facts and similar triangles · 三角形与相似

Angle facts 角的性质

  • Angle sum 内角和: A + B + C = 180°. Example: 50° and 65° → third = 180 − 115 = 65°.
  • Isosceles 等腰: two equal sides → the two base angles are equal. Vertex angle 40° → base angles 180 − 402 = 70° each.
  • Equilateral 等边: all angles 60°.
  • Exterior angle 外角 = the sum of the two far interior angles: 50° + 65° → exterior at the third corner = 115°.

三角形内角和 180°；等腰三角形两底角相等；外角等于不相邻的两个内角之和。

Similar triangles 相似三角形

Similar 相似 ∼: same shape, maybe different size. Corresponding angles are equal; corresponding sides are in the same ratio.

△ ABC ∼ △ DEF, AB = 3, BC = 4, DE = 6. Find EF.

  1. Match in order: A ↔ D, B ↔ E, C ↔ F.
  2. Scale factor: DEAB = 63 = 2.
  3. EF = 2 × BC = 8. Angle E = angle B (angles do not double!).

相似：角相等，边成比例。按字母顺序对应，先求相似比，再乘。两角相等（AA）就能说明相似。

Quick Check

Quick check · Lines, angles, triangles先自己算，再点开看答案

1.Complement and supplement of 35°?
55° and 145°
2.Two lines cross; one angle is 40°. The other three?
140°, 40°, 140°
3.A triangle has angles 50° and 65°. The third angle?
180 − 50 − 65 = 65°
4.Parallel lines: an acute angle is (2x + 10)°, an obtuse angle is 110°. x?
2x + 10 + 110 = 180 → x = 30
5.Isosceles triangle, vertex angle 40°. Each base angle?
180 − 402 = 70°
6.△ ABC ∼ △ DEF, AB = 5, DE = 15, BC = 7. EF?
Scale 3 → EF = 21
Key facts

Angle and triangle rules角与三角形规则

Vertical angles
equal
Linear pair
two angles on a straight line add to 180°
Parallel lines + transversal
acute angles all equal, obtuse angles all equal; acute + obtuse = 180°
Triangle angle sum
A + B + C = 180°
Right triangle
the two acute angles add to 90°
Similar triangles
corresponding angles equal; sideside ratios equal
Congruent triangles
similar and one pair of corresponding sides equal (ASA, AAS, SAS, SSS)
Parallel segment in a triangle
creates a smaller similar triangle

Write the correspondence in order: “LMN ∼ PQR, L ↔ P, M ↔ Q” means angle M = angle Q. Similar triangles never change angle measures, even when the sides double. 按对应顺序写出对应顶点；相似只改变边长，不改变角。

How to approach it

Steps

1

Mark what is equal and what adds to 180°

Vertical angles, parallel lines, straight lines, triangle sums. 标出相等的角和互补的角。

2

Write an equation

If angles are expressions (6k + 13), set equal or make them add to 180°, then solve. 角用代数式表示时，列方程求解。

3

Trust the facts, not the picture

“Figure not drawn to scale” → do not measure; use the rules. 图不按比例时只用性质，不靠目测。

Example 1

Form 4 · Math Module 2 · Question 16

Form 4 · Math Module 2 · Question 16

先自己想 1–2 分钟，再点开完整解析。

Idea · 思路

x and y are vertical angles → equal. Find k, then x. Then use the parallel lines to relate z to x.

x、y 是对顶角 → 相等；再用平行线求 z。

Solution · 解析

  1. Vertical angles: 6k + 13 = 8k − 29 → 42 = 2k → k = 21.
  2. Find x: x = 6(21) + 13 = 139. (Check: y = 8(21) − 29 = 139 ✓)
  3. Parallel lines: At line n, z is the acute angle; x is obtuse. Acute + obtuse = 180°.
  4. Find z: z = 180 − 139 = 41.

Why not the others · 错误选项

A ✗ 3 may come from a calculation error.
B ✗ 21 is the value of k, not an angle.
D ✗ 139 is x (and y), the obtuse angle; z is acute.

Answer: C. z = 41 Takeaway. Find the unknown with an equal-angle or 180° equation, then answer the angle that was asked. 先用相等或互补列方程，再求所问的角。

对顶角相等。

Idea · 思路

The three angles of a triangle add to 180°.

Solution · 解析

  1. A = 180 − 52 − 17 = 111°.
三角形内角和 180°。

Why not the others · 错误选项

B ✗ 35 = 52 − 17.

Example 4

Form 5 · Math Module 2 · Question 16

Form 5 · Math Module 2 · Question 16

先自己想 1–2 分钟，再点开完整解析。

Idea · 思路

R is 63°. How large can the other two angles be together?

Solution · 解析

  1. S + T = 180 − 63 = 117, and T > 0, so S < 117.
  2. Only 116 is less than 117.
另外两角之和为 117°，S 必须小于 117。

Why not the others · 错误选项

B ✗ 118 > 117 leaves no room for angle T.
C ✗ 126 > 117.
D ✗ 180 is the sum of all three angles.

Answer: A.

Summary

What to remember about lines, angles, and triangles直线、角与三角形要点

01 · 对顶角与平角

Vertical angles are equal; angles on a straight line add to 180°.

02 · 平行线角关系

Parallel lines: all acute angles equal, all obtuse angles equal, acute + obtuse = 180°.

03 · 三角形内角

Triangle angles add to 180°; the acute angles of a right triangle add to 90°.

04 · 相似三角形

Similar triangles: equal corresponding angles, proportional sides. A parallel segment makes a similar triangle.

05 · 相似与全等

Similar + one pair of equal corresponding sides → congruent.

06 · 30 秒自检

What is being asked? Which equation or rule applies? How can you check the result?

说清所求 → 选公式或列式 → 代回或检查单位。
